messages.quest.field_medicine.clean_bandages.desc: Help prepare simple medical supplies before the next village injury.
quest.field_medicine.clean_bandages.stag: When someone is hurt, everyone suddenly believes in preparation.
I would rather prepare before the shouting. Bring clean wool and string first; rough hands can still be careful hands.
Clean cloth first. It is dull work until the moment it is everything.
messages.quest.field_medicine.clean_bandages.stag: Bring 6 string to tie splints and wraps.
Bring 8 white wool for clean bandages.
quest.field_medicine.clean_bandages.stag: Then I will keep folding what little we have and hope not to need it.
Keep it clean if you can. Dirt always arrives without being invited.
Bring 8 white wool and 6 string for clean bandages.
The bandage kit is not ready for that work right now.
The bandage kit is already prepared.
Bring 8 white wool and 6 string. Quiet supplies save loud minutes.
The medicine kit is not ready to ask for help right now.
Clean cloth, tied wraps, sealed bottles. This is the kind of mercy that fits on a shelf.
Good. No one will cheer for a stocked medicine kit, and that is how I prefer it.
The kit still needs its cloth, string, honey, or clean bottles before we seal it.
Bring the medical supplies here so I can count them cleanly.
I cannot close the medicine kit right now.
Care left half-done has a way of being noticed at the worst possible moment.
messages.quest.field_medicine.clean_bandages.stag: Return with the field medicine supplies.
quest.field_medicine.clean_bandages.stag: The wraps are ready. Now we need sealed bottles and honey, the kind of simple medicine no one praises until they can breathe again.
messages.quest.field_medicine.clean_bandages.stag: Bring 4 glass bottles for clean mixtures.
Bring 2 honey bottles for the field kit.
quest.field_medicine.clean_bandages.stag: Label the bottles by memory if you must, but do not trust memory alone.
Bring 2 honey bottles and 4 glass bottles for the field kit.
The jars can wait until the cloth and string are ready.
messages.quest.field_medicine.clean_bandages.stag: Bring 2 honey bottles and 4 glass bottles.
